_readme: Copy this file to cv/variants/variants.json and adapt it to your own CV variants
(the /onboard skill does this for you). scripts/select_variant.py evaluates the
rules in order against the job title; the first matching pattern wins. Patterns
are Python regular expressions, matched case-insensitively.
Each rule's 'variant' must correspond to a cv/variants/<variant>.tex file
'swaps' is optional: when the job description matches any context_patterns
regex and the matched variant appears in variant_map, the mapped alternative
is used instead (e.g. an industry-flavoured version of the same CV).
If this file is missing, select_variant falls back to 'default_variant' from
